_comment: Claims and census lookup entries carried from the FM-MYAD-REG draft ledger (lookups.json). scripts/export_fixtures.py builds ledger-draft/lookups.json from this plus the manifests. Census desks are filled from each pack's manifest (desks live only in manifests).

claims.us.census.incorporated-place: Incorporated place containing the address, or none
claims.us.census.county-subdivision: Census county subdivision (CCD) containing the address
claims.us.census.congressional-district: US House district (120th Congress) containing the address
claims.us-fl.census.state-senate-district: Florida Senate district (2026) containing the address
claims.us-fl.census.state-house-district: Florida House district (2026) containing the address
claims.us-fl-miamidade.government.municipality: Municipality (or UNINCORPORATED MIAMI-DADE) containing the pin
claims.us-fl-miamidade.trash.garbage-days: County garbage collection days for the pin (county service area only)
claims.us-fl-miamidade.trash.recycling-day: County recycling collection weekday for the pin
claims.us-fl-miamidade.trash.recycling-week: County recycling pickup week letter (A/B/C) for the pin
claims.us-fl-miami.trash.day: City of Miami trash day for the pin
claims.us-fl-miamidade.parcel.folio: Folio of the parcel at the pin
claims.us-fl-miamidade.parcel.year-built: Year built of the parcel at the pin (when the county records none, the answer is not_applicable, never 0)
claims.us-fl-miamidade.parcel.condo: Condo flag of the parcel at the pin
claims.us-fl-miamidade.parcel.use: Property use description of the parcel at the pin
claims.us-fl-miamidade.vote.polling-place: Election-day polling place for the pin's precinct
claims.us-fl-miamidade.rep.county-commission.di: County commission district and commissioner - district id
claims.us-fl-miamidade.rep.county-commission.me: County commission district and commissioner - member name as published
claims.us-fl-miamidade.rep.congress.district: US House district and representative (county layer) - district id
claims.us-fl-miamidade.rep.congress.member: US House district and representative (county layer) - member name as published
claims.us-fl-miamidade.rep.state-senate.distric: Florida Senate district and senator (county layer) - district id
claims.us-fl-miamidade.rep.state-senate.member: Florida Senate district and senator (county layer) - member name as published
claims.us-fl-miamidade.rep.state-house.district: Florida House district and representative (county layer) - district id
claims.us-fl-miamidade.rep.state-house.member: Florida House district and representative (county layer) - member name as published
claims.us-fl-miamidade.rep.school-board.distric: School board district and member - district id
claims.us-fl-miamidade.rep.school-board.member: School board district and member - member name as published
claims.us-fl-miamidade.transit.nearest-stop: Nearest Miami-Dade Transit stop (rank suffix), straight-line distance
claims.us-fl-miamidade.government.municipality-: County MUNICID of the municipality (or unincorporated area) containing the pin
claims.us-fl-miamidade.transit.nearest-stop.rou: Route short names serving that stop
claims.us-fl-miamidade.rent.line: Rent line for the pin from Miami-Dade County's own table (not yet sourced: unsourced with the county housing desk)
